notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Izzet Chronarch.
When Dockside Extortionist and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
